_about: The 10 canonical utterances (voice_guide_redesign.md section 11) mapped to the terse CCL command string the guide should emit, plus the minimal expected parse. Two masters: (1) the increment-0 spike scores model English->CCL accuracy against expected_command (>=8/10 clean or grammar-fixable is the exit gate); (2) scripts/test_voice_ccl.mjs smoke-parses each expected_command and checks verb/dim/op/args. Rows with expected_command:null are deferred in v1 (the guide asks rather than inventing) and are not parse-checked. Keys beginning with _ are documentation.
